even-depth deletion strictly enlarges the quotient in tested cases

verdict: The native multi-current tower is a parity-decimation phenomenon. Restoring consecutive depths collapses its tested quotient to width one or two, while either parity coset alone retains multiple alias classes. An explicit nearest-neighbor chain relation remains to prove.
